description: Four slots that set the playing level of a drum sound from a trigger, with a louder level for accented hits, voltage control over both levels, and chokes between neighbouring slots

params.text: Switches choking on between that slot and the one to its right, so a trigger here silences that neighbour over 1ms
Sets the level that slot plays at when its TRG fires with ACC low, 0 to 200%
Scales that slot's standard-level CV, -100% to +100%
Sets the level that slot plays at when its TRG fires with ACC high, 0 to 200%
Scales that slot's accent-level CV, -100% to +100%

inputs.text: A trigger here reads the ACC jack and fixes that slot's level from the standard or the accent setting
Shifts that slot's standard level, a tenth of its voltage scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the knob
Held above 1V as that slot's TRG fires, the accent level is used for that hit instead of the standard level
Shifts that slot's accent level, a tenth of its voltage scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the knob
The drum sound for that slot, which is passed through at the level the last trigger fixed

outputs.text: That slot's sound at its set level, plus any slot above whose own output has no cable in it

notes: a slot passes nothing until a cable is in its TRG jack; with that jack empty its output stays at 0V.
with a CHK switch on, the slot to its right passes nothing until a trigger has arrived at that slot's own TRG jack.
both level CVs are sampled only at the instant a trigger arrives, so moving them between hits changes nothing until the next one.
